title: $\mathbb{A}^1$-connectedness of moduli of semistable bundles and symplectic bundles on a curve
summary: In this note, we show that over a geometrically irreducible smooth projective curve over an infinite field $k$, the moduli stack of semistable vector bundles of fixed determinant is $\mathbb{A}^1$-connected if and only if the moduli stack admits a $k$-rational point. For this we use Langton's elementary modifications for vector bundles at the level of families.
